KevBox TV uses the TMDB API for movie and TV metadata, artwork, trailers, cast, production details, collections, and recommendations. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
KevBox TV connects to Trakt for account authentication, watched history, progress sync, library data, ratings, lists, and comments. KevBox TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by Trakt.
KevBox TV connects to Premiumize for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. KevBox TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by Premiumize.
KevBox TV connects to TorBox for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. KevBox TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by TorBox.
KevBox TV uses MDBList for ratings and external score provider data. KevBox TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by MDBList.
KevBox TV uses the IntroDB API for community-provided intro, recap, credits, and preview timestamps used by skip controls. KevBox TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by IntroDB.
